title: Deserialize a struct from a nested path
author: nerjs

title: deserialize_in_place breaks Deserialize for packed structs
author: bbrown-oai
body_preview: Deriving `Deserialize` for a packed struct fails with E0793 when `serde_derive`’s `deserialize_in_place` feature is enabled. The same type compiles when that feature is disabled. title: Serde drops error source information when deserializing using try_from
author: axoking
body_preview: When using a custom type and `#[serde(try_from = "..."]`, errors that the `try_from` call throws are not forwarded correctly. Instead, they are converted into strings with no control about how the conversion behaves, and the original error is dropped instead of saving it as a source.
